scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "bun run dev:backend" "bun run dev:frontend"
scripts.sync: cd backend && bun run sync:daily && bun run sync:starred:recent
scripts.sync:all: cd backend && bun run sync:trending && bun run sync:starred
scripts.data:update: bun run sync && bun run data:sync:digest && bun run data:sync:awesome-dsh && bun run data:export
scripts.data:update:window: bun run data:sync:window && bun run data:export
scripts.build: cd backend && bun run build && cd ../frontend && bun run build
scripts.start: bun run build && cd backend && bun run start
scripts.build:static: cd backend && bun run export:incremental && cd ../frontend && VITE_STATIC_MODE=true bun run build
scripts.typecheck: cd backend && bun run typecheck && cd ../frontend && bun run typecheck && cd ../dsh && bun run typecheck
scripts.dev:seed: bun run data:seed && bun run dev
scripts.predev: node --eval "process.exit(require('fs').existsSync('frontend/node_modules/@innate/ui')?0:1)" || innate-fe-cli install --dir frontend && cp frontend/.npmrc .npmrc
scripts.predev:seed: node --eval "process.exit(require('fs').existsSync('frontend/node_modules/@innate/ui')?0:1)" || innate-fe-cli install --dir frontend && cp frontend/.npmrc .npmrc
scripts.data:update:local: bun run sync && bun run data:sync:digest && bun run data:sync:topics && bun run data:sync:external
